tasks.description: The change adds a new read-only API endpoint (GET .../signals/scout/runs/{run_id}/emissions/reports/) plus serializers, a ClickHouse helper, generated frontend types, and an MCP tool registration that is disabled by default. The scout harness viewsets are internal HTTP surfaces for MCP consumption (views.py docstring), and the new MCP tool is `enabled: false` in tools.yaml, so it is not part of any user-facing tool list. The user-facing Inbox docs (contents/docs/posthog-code/inbox/index.mdx and sources.mdx) describe the report→signals direction and the research flow but do not enumerate scout API endpoints or MCP tool tables, so there is no existing page that lists this endpoint or would need the reverse-lookup added. The actual user-visible chip lands in a follow-up desktop app PR (posthog/code), not in this repo's docs. No user-facing documentation update is warranted for this backend-only endpoint.
